title: French-Style Baby Potatoes
description: A simple and delicious French-inspired side dish featuring baby potatoes.
instructions: 2. Scrub the baby potatoes clean and cut them in half.
3. In a bowl, toss the potatoes with light oil, salt, and minced garlic until well coated.
4. Spread the potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
5. Roast the potatoes in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and golden brown.
6. Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool slightly.
7. Sprinkle chopped parsley over the potatoes and serve hot.
